title: Further Report On Male Chinese Taken Away By Members Of The Japanese Naval Landing Party

page_data.en:
Noting for Officer i/c. Special Branch.
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
North Soochow Road Station,
REPORT
Date Sept. 14, 1937.
Subject Further report on male Chinese taken away by members of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party.
Made by D.S.I. Kennedy Forwarded by R. Fairbairn Inspector
Officer in charge

Sir,
Two of the male Chinese mentioned in the previous reports -
Lee Tsaung Paung and his brother Lee Tsaung Nyi were released from
Hongkew Police Station at 9 a.m. 13-9-37. The third man named
Lee Ah Tsang is still detained in the custody of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party.
Reference to the Indian watchman Buhr Singh previously
employed at House 1, Lane 490 Haining Road, a memo (attached)
written by Mr. Fairbairn, A.C.P. was handed in to the undersigned
by Inspector Blenkinsop, West Hongkew Station at 3 p.m. 14-9-37.
The memo stated that as Buhr Singh is not permitted to return
to the district where he was previously employed, he wished to
have his belongings which he had left behind him at House 1, Lane
490 Haining Road, forwarded to A.C. (Sikh)'s office. The list
of his alleged personal belongings is attached, but when enquiries
were made at the above mentioned address, the two Indian watchmen
at present employed there, stated that Buhr Singh's possessions
consisted of one sack flour, 2 lbs of rice and one pair of
trousers, the remainder of the property listed, belonging to his
employer, and he (Buhr Singh) had no claim to same.
Since the dismissal of Buhr Singh another Indian watchman
named Rangit Singh has been engaged by the proprietor of the
premises. The two watchmen employed there, have been warned that
no further trouble caused by them would be tolerated. The property
belonging to Buhr Singh will be forwarded to A.C.(Sikh)'s office
on 15-9-37.
The only other residence in this sector where Indian
watchmen are employed, is the premises formerly occupied by Mr.
Chung Bing Him and almost totally destroyed by a bomb explosion

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
北苏州路捕房，
报告
日期：1937年9月14日。
事由：关于被日本海军陆战队成员带走的华籍男子的进一步报告。
呈报人：副督察长肯尼迪（Kennedy） 转呈人：费尔贝恩（R. Fairbairn）督察
主管警官

先生：
前次报告中提及的两名华籍男子——李庄邦（Lee Tsaung Paung）及其弟李庄尼（Lee Tsaung Nyi）已于1937年9月13日上午9时从虹口捕房获释。第三名男子李阿昌（Lee Ah Tsang）仍被日本海军陆战队拘押。
关于此前受雇于海宁路490弄1号的印度看门人布尔·辛格（Buhr Singh），西区虹口捕房的布伦金索普（Blenkinsop）督察于1937年9月14日下午3时向卑职递交了一份由助理警务处长费尔贝恩先生撰写的备忘录（附后）。该备忘录指出，由于布尔·辛格不被允许返回其先前受雇的地区，他希望将其留在海宁路490弄1号的私人物品 forwarded 至锡克教助理警务处长（A.C. (Sikh)）办公室。其所称个人物品的清单已附上，但在上述地址进行查询时，目前受雇于此的两名印度看门人表示，布尔·辛格的财物仅包括一袋面粉、2磅大米和一条裤子，清单上列出的其余财产属于其雇主，他（布尔·辛格）无权索取。
自布尔·辛格被解雇后，该房产业主又雇用了一名名为兰吉特·辛格（Rangit Singh）的印度看门人。已警告在此受雇的两名看门人，不得再惹是生非。属于布尔·辛格的财产将于1937年9月15日送往锡克教助理警务处长办公室。
本区域内另一处雇用印度看门人的住所，是钟炳谦（Chung Bing Him，音译）先生此前占据的房产，该处在一次炸弹爆炸中几乎被完全摧毁

Date Sept. 13, 19 37.

Subject Further report re male Chinese taken away by members of the Japanese Naval Landing Party.

Made by D.S.I. Kennedy Forwarded by R. S. Jabrum Inspector
Officer in charge

Sir,
At 2.00p.m. 12-9-37 a Mr. Loo Kyah Ming present address House 26, Lane 909 Yue Yuen Road came to this Station seeking information regarding his employee Lee Tsaung Paung who had been taken away from Lane 490 Haining Road by members of the Japanese Naval Landing Party on 11-9-37. Mr. Loo was accompanied by one named Lee Tsaung Nyi a brother of the missing man who had also been taken away at the same time by members of the J.N.L.Party but subsequently succeeded in making good his escape. Lee Tsaung Nyi on being questioned by D.S. Fowler, stated that his brother was detained at No. 421 Haining Road just east of North Szechuen Road. J.P.C.212 from Hongkew Station attended and accompanied by D.S. Fowler proceeded to 421 Haining Road, where the missing man Lee Tsaung Paung and another male Chinese named Lee Ah Tsang were found hiding in an upstairs room at this address. The facts of the case were explained by D.S. Fowler to the Officer in charge of the detachment of marines stationed at the corner of Haining and North Szechuen Roads, which resulted in Lee Tsaung Paung, Lee Ah Tsang, and the witness Lee Tsaung Nyi being taken to the Chapoo Road Sub Station of the J.N.L. Party for further questioning regarding the allegations made against them by the Indian watchman Buhr Singh, and if no evidence was forthcoming against the three men concerned, they would be released on the morning of 13-9-37. The four male Chinese aforementioned after their arrest by the members of the J.N.L. Party at Lane 490 Haining Road were taken to 491 Haining Road immediately in the rear of the J.N.L.Party post at Haining and North Szechuen Roads. They were tied up with ropes and left there without a guard. Lee Tsaung Nyi and one Wong Nyi Kyung subsequently succeeded in

事由：关于被日本海军陆战队成员带走的华籍男子的进一步报告。

呈报人：副督察长肯尼迪 转呈人：贾布鲁姆（R. S. Jabrum）督察
主管警官

先生：
1937年9月12日下午2时，现住址为岳园路909弄26号的陆启明（Loo Kyah Ming，音译）先生来到本捕房，查询其雇员李庄邦的情况。李庄邦于1937年9月11日被日本海军陆战队成员从海宁路490弄带走。陆先生由失踪者的兄弟李庄尼陪同前来，李庄尼当时也被日本海军陆战队成员同时带走，但随后成功逃脱。副警司福勒（Fowler）讯问李庄尼时，他陈述其兄弟被拘禁在海宁路421号，位于北四川路以东。虹口捕房的警员编号212出警，并在副警司福勒的陪同下前往海宁路421号，在那里发现失踪男子李庄邦和另一名华籍男子李阿昌藏匿于该地址楼上的房间内。副警司福勒向驻守在海宁路与北四川路拐角处的海军陆战队分队负责人说明了案情，结果导致李庄邦、李阿昌以及证人李庄尼被带往日本海军陆战队乍浦路分遣队，就印度看门人布尔·辛格对他们的指控进行进一步讯问，并告知若查无实据，这三人将于1937年9月13日上午获释。前述四名华籍男子在日本海军陆战队成员于海宁路490弄逮捕他们后，立即被带往海宁路与北四川路日本海军陆战队哨所正后方的海宁路491号。他们被绳索捆绑并留在那里，无人看守。李庄尼和一名黄尼京（Wong Nyi Kyung，音译）随后成功

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
North Soochow Road Station,
REPORT
Date Sept. 12, 1937.

Subject Male Chinese taken away by members of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party.

Made by D.S.I. Kennedy Forwarded [Signature] Inspector
Officer in charge

Sir,
At 5p.m. 11-9-37 a Chinese female named Lee Loo Sz, 27 years
native of Tungchow and residing at Route Conty, No. unknown, came
to the Station and reported that her husband one named Lee Tsaung
Paung had been taken away about 1 p.m. 11-9-37 by members of the
Japanese Naval Landing Party from Lane 490 off Haining Road where
he was employed as watchman. The female made allegations against
an Indian watchman named Buhr Singh as being concerned in giving
information to the members of the Japanese Naval Landing Party
which led to her husband's disappearance.

The undersigned, D.S. Fowler and C.D.C.200 proceeded to the
scene and made the following enquiries. Lane 490 is situated on
the north side of Haining Road just east of North Kiangse Road,
this area at present being a sort of "no man's land" between the
British and Japanese forces defending this sector. House 1, Lane
490 Haining Road was previously occupied by a wealthy Cantonese
family who employed two Indian watchman who remained on the
premises after the remainder of the inmates had evacuated. When
Police visited the premises this P.M. it was ascertained that
other five unemployed Indians are at present residing in the house,
being friends of the two watchman who are regularly employed.

A male Chinese named Lee Tsaung Nyi, 28 years native of
Tungchow brother of the missing male Chinese Lee Tsaung Paung was
located at Lane 490 Haining Road, and on being questioned was able
to give Police the following particulars. Both he and his brother
have been employed as private watchman in this alleyway for a
considerable period and remained there after some of the tenants
vacated at the commencement of hostilities. They incurred the
enmity of one named Buhr Singh who is one the Indian watchmen

北苏州路捕房，
报告
日期：1937年9月12日。

事由：被日本海军陆战队成员带走的华籍男子。

呈报人：副督察长肯尼迪 转呈人：[签名] 督察
主管警官

先生：
1937年9月11日下午5时，一名名叫李鲁氏（Lee Loo Sz，音译）的27岁中国女性，籍贯通州，居住在康悌路（Route Conty，今建国东路）某号（门牌不详），来到捕房报案，称其丈夫李庄邦于1937年9月11日下午1时许，在海宁路490弄被日本海军陆战队成员带走，他在那里担任看门人。该女子指控一名名叫布尔·辛格的印度看门人参与向日本海军陆战队成员提供情报，导致其丈夫失踪。

卑职与副警司福勒及巡长编号200前往现场并进行如下调查。海宁路490弄位于海宁路北侧，江西路以东，该区域目前是保卫该防区的英军与日军之间的某种“无人区”。海宁路490弄1号此前由一个富裕的广东家庭居住，该家庭雇用两名印度看门人，在其他住户撤离后，这两名看门人仍留在该处。当警方于今日下午访问该处时，查明另有五名失业的印度人目前居住在该屋内，他们是两名正式受雇看门人的朋友。

在海宁路490弄找到了一名28岁的华籍男子李庄尼，籍贯通州，是失踪华籍男子李庄邦的兄弟。经讯问，他能向警方提供以下详情。他和他的兄弟在这条弄堂里担任私人看门人已有一段相当长的时间，并在敌对行动开始部分租户搬离后仍留在那里。他们得罪了一名名叫布尔·辛格的人，此人是受雇于海宁路490弄1号的印度看门人之一

employed at House 1, Lane 490 Haining Road, on account of refusing
to give the watchman free rice and water. The latter in
retaliation reported to the members of the Japanese Naval Landing
Party on duty at Haining and North Szechuen Roads, that the
brothers were bad characters and were giving information regarding
the Japanese, to the Chinese troops stationed in the vicinity.
This resulted in several Japanese Marines proceeding to Lane 490
Haining Road about 1 p.m. 11-9-37 and arresting the two brothers,
also another friend of theirs, named Wong Nyi Kyung also employed
as watchman at this alleyway. Both Lee Tsaung Nyi and Wong Nyi
Kyung were badly beaten by the members of the Japanese Naval Landing
Party and were subsequently released, but the fate of the other man
Lee Tsaung Paung is unknown. Prior to the Police proceeding to
Lane 490 Haining Road permission was obtained from Lieut. Clark in
charge of this sector, to make the necessary enquiries. Japanese
Marines stationed at North Szechuen and Haining Roads were
questioned but nothing was learnt re the missing man's whereabouts.
The Indian watchman Buhr Singh against whom the allegations
were made, was located, and brought along to West Hongkew Station
for enquiries. Special Branch were informed and D.I. Fouja Singh
attended, and assisted in enquiries. It appears that Buhr Singh is
a well known seditionist and bad character having previously been
charged in H.M.'s British Court. Enquiries made among the tenants
at Lane 490 Haining Road ascertained that he has been molesting and
making indecent overtures to females who evacuated this alleyway
and returned in order to ascertain whether their belongings were
intact. It is also suspected by Police operating from this Station
that the Indian watchmen who visit House 1, Lane 490 Haining Road
have been responsible for a good deal of looting in this locality.

之所以得罪他，是因为拒绝免费向该看门人提供米和水。后者作为报复，向驻守在海宁路和北四川路的日本海军陆战队执勤人员报告，称这两兄弟品行不端，并向附近驻扎的中国军队提供有关日军的情报。这导致几名日本海军陆战队员于1937年9月11日下午1时许前往海宁路490弄，逮捕了这两兄弟，以及他们的另一位朋友黄尼京，他也在这条弄堂里担任看门人。李庄尼和黄尼京均遭到日本海军陆战队成员的毒打，随后被释放，但另一人李庄邦的下落不明。在警方前往海宁路490弄之前，已获得负责该防区的克拉克（Clark）中尉的许可，以进行必要的调查。虽对驻守在北四川路和海宁路的日本海军陆战队员进行了询问，但未获悉失踪者的下落。
被指控的印度看门人布尔·辛格已被找到，并被带至西区虹口捕房接受讯问。特别处已获通知，督察富贾·辛格（Fouja Singh）到场并协助调查。看来布尔·辛格是一个众所周知的煽动分子和劣迹斑斑之人，此前曾在英国皇家法院被起诉。对海宁路490弄租户的调查查明，他曾骚扰并对此前撤离该弄堂、后返回查看财物是否完好无损的女性做出猥亵举动。本捕房行动的警方还怀疑，造访海宁路490弄1号的印度看门人对该地区的大量抢劫活动负有责任。

as they can walk through the Japanese lines along North Szechuen
Road without being questioned. After the particulars regarding
Buhr Singh were ascertained at West Hongkew Station, he was taken
back and handed over to Lieut. Clark R.W.F. for further
questioning. It was also learnt regarding Buhr Singh that he
had been asked to leave Shanghai for India on 10-9-37 but
refused.
The undersigned would like to point out the danger that
exists in people still living in the block comprising North
Kiangse, Range, North Szechuen and Haining Roads. As previously
mentioned, it forms a sort of no man's land between both forces,
and if the tenants were forced to evacuate, it would save a
great deal of trouble for the British Forces stationed there, as
they are loath to refuse admittance to Chinese who present all
manner of credentials with a view to get permission to proceed
to their homes in this sector, and remove property. This is the

卑职谨指出，目前仍居住在由江西路、仁记路（Range，音译，或指某条小路）、北四川路和海宁路组成的街区的人们存在危险。如前所述，该区域构成了双方部队之间的某种无人区，如果强制租户撤离，将为驻守那里的英军省去许多麻烦，因为他们不愿拒绝持有各种证明文件以求获准进入该区域住所并搬运财产的中国人。这是本捕房收到的关于日本海军陆战队成员在该地区活动的第一起投诉，如果允许租户继续停留，无疑会发生许多类似性质的事件。
